entries.title: Simpler homepage, clearer benchmarks and free standard scans
changes: Free accounts now get 5 standard scans a day. The ₹99 pack includes unlimited standard scans and 10 Extended scans, with no expiry or automatic renewal.
Shortened the homepage and added benchmark coverage, UTC run inspection and exact graph values.
Improved page-specific search titles and descriptions across the platform directory, guides and comparisons.

entries.title: Daily public benchmark graphs
changes: Added daily false-positive, accuracy and execution-time graphs for ten fixed public username controls across three platforms.
Published per-platform reference verdicts, unknown outcomes, timestamps and code revisions with each run.
Scheduled daily updates at 03:17 UTC; unavailable references remain excluded from scored metrics.

entries.title: Search resilience and public data handling details
changes: Bounded Google query concurrency with pacing, jitter, transient retries and provider cooldowns.
Partial lookup failures retain successful findings and show source-specific warnings.
Email API lookups run live without application result caching or account database retention.
Added visible privacy disclosures and a benchmark evidence placeholder. No measured accuracy or speed claims are published.
